title: Freeze Your Credit In Three Steps

beats.say: You can lock down your credit for free in three steps, and it takes about fifteen minutes.
beats.visual: a brass padlock on a dark wooden door in warm side light, no people

beats.say: Since September two thousand eighteen, federal law has made credit freezes free.
beats.visual: a folded paper letter with a wax seal on a dark desk, soft light, no people

beats.say: Step one. Contact each of the three credit bureaus: Equifax, Experian and TransUnion.
beats.visual: three identical steel mailboxes in a row on a quiet street at dawn, no people

beats.say: You have to freeze at all three, because each keeps its own file on you.
beats.visual: three identical white folders fanned on a clean desk, soft morning light

beats.say: Step two. Place the freeze online or by phone, and the bureau must apply it within one business day.
beats.visual: a hand pressing a single key on an old brass typewriter, close-up, no faces

beats.say: Keep your login or PIN somewhere safe, because you will need it later.
beats.visual: a small key resting on a closed notebook on a wooden table, macro, no people

beats.say: Step three. When you apply for credit, lift the freeze for free, then freeze it again.
beats.visual: a door held ajar by a small wooden wedge in warm hallway light, no people

beats.say: A freeze limits new creditors from opening accounts in your name.
beats.visual: a heavy iron gate closed across an old stone archway at dusk, no people

beats.say: Here is the part nobody tells you. A freeze does not stop misuse of cards and accounts you already have.
beats.visual: a row of old brass keys hanging on a wall hook in dim light, no people

beats.say: The honest catch: a freeze is not a full shield, so keep checking your statements.
beats.visual: a stormy sea with waves rising under a heavy sky and a lighthouse in the distance, no people

beats.say: Plan ahead, because you will need to thaw it before a loan, card or rental application.
beats.visual: a paper calendar with one date circled in soft window light, no people

beats.say: This is education, not advice. Check each bureau's website for the current steps.
beats.visual: a quiet kitchen table at morning with a coffee cup and a notepad, no people

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: an empty highway stretching toward a glowing sunrise horizon, wide shot, no people

description: Credit freezes have been free by federal law since September 2018. Contact Equifax, Experian and TransUnion, place the freeze online or by phone, and lift it temporarily when you apply for credit. A freeze limits new accounts in your name but does not stop misuse of existing accounts. Educational only, not financial advice.
first_comment: Have you frozen your credit yet? Educational only, not financial advice.

facts.claim: Since 2018-09-21 you can place and lift credit freezes for free at the nationwide credit bureaus
facts.basis: FTC press release 2018-09, Economic Growth, Regulatory Relief and Consumer Protection Act

facts.claim: Online or phone freeze requests must be applied within one business day; by mail within three
facts.basis: FTC consumer alert, Free credit freezes are here, 2018-09

facts.claim: You must contact each of Equifax, Experian and TransUnion separately for a freeze

caption: Credit freezes are free by federal law. Three steps: contact Equifax, Experian and TransUnion; place the freeze; lift it only when you apply for credit. Not a full shield. Educational content, not financial advice.
